verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official CLI whose documented quick-start is `npm i -g vercel`, `vercel login`, `vercel`, which deploys straight from the terminal. The getting-started guide frames deployment as install the CLI and deploy, and access tokens authenticate the CLI for automated, non-dashboard use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI deploy flow, and in-depth documentation of deploy-specific options such as production vs. preview flags.
